simple.meaning: אַתָּה (ʼattâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “thou and thee , or (plural) ye and you.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1104 times across Genesis, Exodus, beginning at Genesis 3:11. Its contexts include family, blood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַתָּה (H859).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אַתָּה (ʼattâh) / H859 is traced through Genesis 3:11, Genesis 3:14, Genesis 3:15, Genesis 3:19 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: thou and thee , or (plural) ye and you
definitions.full: H859. attah אָ֑תָּה אַתָּ֫ה, (so regularly; but 26-7 t., with different disjunctive accents, ׃אַ֑תָּה see Fr MM 228 ; Sta § 178 a (read 8 for 18) pronoun 2 singular masculine thou (for anta , see above; compare נָתַתָּ for נָתַנְתָּ ) Gen 3:11 , 19 +? אַתָּ 1Sam 24:19 ; Psa 6:4 ; Job 1:10 ; Eccl 7:22 ; Neh 9:6 . Appended to a verb for emphasis, Exod 18:19 (twice in verse); 1Sam 17:56 אַתָּה שְׁאַל inquire thou , 20:8 ; 22:18 ; Isa 43:26 אַתָּה סַמֵּר . Added for the purpose of strengthening a Genitive or accusative suffix 1Kin 21:19 ; Prov 22:19 (Ges § 135 .2). אתי , i.e. אַתִּי , the older & more original form of אַתְּ thou (feminine), preserved, probably dialectically, 7 t. in Kt, Judg 17:2 ; 1Kin 14:2 ; 2Kin 4:16 , 23 ; 8:1 ; Jer 4:30 ; Ezek 36:13 . (V. above as in Syriac, the י may not have been fully sounded: the Masoretes direct אַתְּ to be everywhere read.) אָ֑תְּ אַתְּ, pronoun 2 singular feminine thou (feminine) (shortened from אַתִּי (q. v.); in Syriac the two Genders are written differently, , , but, the not being sounded, are pronounced alike: in ᵑ7 both are written אַתְּ or אַנְתְּ ) Gen 12:11 , 13 ; 24:23 +? Num 11:15 ; Deut 5:24 ; Ezek 28:14 used as a masculine (as in Aramaic of ᵑ7 ); but probably אַתָּ (see below אַתָּה ) should be here read. אַתֶּם pronoun 2 masculine plural you (masculine) (for antem , see above) Gen 9:7 ; 26:27 ; 29:4 +? הָאַתֶּם הֲ, Judg 6:31 ; following the verb for emphasis 15:12 ; Jer 34:15 ; construed inaccurately with a feminine Ezek 13:20 . אַתֵּן Ezek 34:31 (many editions אַתֶּן ), אַתֵּ֫נָה Gen 31:6 ; Ezek 13:11 , 20 (editions אַתֵּ֫נָּה ) 34:17 pronoun 2 feminine plural you (feminine) I. אסה (perhaps compare Arabic heal , Aramaic אֲסָא , ).
